reason: Imports model providers from the local CCSWITCH database into DSH settings and credentials through AI tools and a GUI.

summaries.zh: 从本地 CCSWITCH 数据库读取模型供应商，并通过工具或设置页批量导入到 DSH。
summaries.en: Reads model providers from the local CCSWITCH database and batch-imports them into DSH through tools or a settings interface.

capabilities: Reads the local CCSWITCH SQLite database through a subprocess
Lists saved model providers and their import eligibility
Writes imported provider settings to DSH
Writes provider credentials to DSH credential storage
Provides AI tools and a GUI for selecting and importing providers
